messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — customer AcmePay hit a 403 on generate after their SSO sync earlier today. They can still call embeddings/rerank but generation fails. Repro steps pasted below. Can someone take a quick look?

Maria (CS): Repro: 1) Login via SSO 2) Use the provisioned svc token 3) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}' => 403.

Maria (CS): Decoded token claims (removed noise):
```
{
  "sub": "svc-acmepay-123",
  "tenant": "acmepay",
  "entitlements": "embeddings,rerank",
  "iat": 1680000000
}
```

Maria (CS): Note: generate/inference not in entitlements string. Customer insists their IdP sent full scopes.

Jon (Eng): Thanks — can you paste raw Authorization header (redact token) and the SSO timestamp? also did they rotate keys?

Maria (CS): Header ok, SSO sync at 2024-04-09T15:12Z. They said they did a user sync only, no manual key rotation.

Sasha (Infra): We pushed a small claim-sanitizer change yesterday that normalizes scope separators (we split on "," only). If the IdP is sending semicolons or spaces we might be dropping unknown tokens. Could be trimming any scope that doesn't match our allowlist ("generate","embeddings","rerank").

Sasha (Infra): Can you run this quick decode on the token and post the raw entitlements field? e.g.
```
python -c "import jwt,sys,json; print(json.loads(jwt.decode('<token>', options={'verify_signature':False}))['entitlements'])"
```

Maria (CS): Customer pasted back raw claim: `embeddings;rerank;generate` (semicolons). They said the claim arrived like that from the IdP.

Jon (Eng): There we go — sanitizer only splits on commas, so the semicolon-containing single string didn't map to individual scopes. Our allowlist then filtered because exact matches weren't found.

Oliver (Sec): Quick mitigation: we can relax the sanitizer to split on `[,;\s]+` and also accept common synonyms (e.g., "gen" -> "generate") for a short window. Need change reviewed but low risk.

Sasha (Infra): Deploying a hotfix to claim-sanitizer to handle semicolons/spaces and a tiny autosuggest map for synonyms. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy claim-sanitizer v1.3.7 to ingress (sha: ab12cd) — started 2024-04-10T08:03:22Z

Sasha (Infra): Hotfix live in canary. Maria, can you ask AcmePay to re-run the curl?

Maria (CS): Re-tested with customer — generation now succeeds, no 403. :tada: They confirmed their IdP sends semicolons.

Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Jon/Sasha file a follow-up to update parser unit tests for multiple separators. 2) Add a note to SSO integrations docs about accepted separators. 3) Notify enterprise onboarding to check IdP claim formats.

Jon (Eng): Filed ENG-4521 for parser tests and ENG-4522 for integration docs.

Oliver (Sec): I'll add a brief blurb to the SSO security checklist to avoid future surprises.

Maria (CS): Thanks all — closing from CS side once tickets are linked to the account.
